# Panora Go

> Panora Go is Zimbabwe's premium tourism and lifestyle discovery platform.
> Tagline: Discover. Connect. Belong.

Panora Go (also PGO) helps travellers and locals find curated places across Zimbabwe — restaurants, weekend escapes, rituals, and experiences with insider notes. There is no inventory booking engine; guests enquire with a concierge team.

## Key pages

- Home: /
- Discover (search): /discover
- Map: /map
- The Panora Way: /the-panora-way
- About: /about
- Enquire: /enquiry
- Smart share places: /p/{slug}
- Place detail: /panoras/{slug}
